label: For "Audio and Video Evidence Transcription and Search": Transcribe recorded interviews and bodycam audio and make them searchable by time and phrase, with speaker turns marked, so reviewers find relevant moments without watching everything. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Voice identification.
